DOP: nissaggiya mfn. and n. , 1. [ cf BHS niḥsargika, naiḥsargika], subject to forfeiture; required to be surrendered; (an offence) involving surrendering, involving forfeiture ; Vin I 196, 14 (mā no ~aṃ ahosī ti); III 195, 1 (ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa ~ā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti); 195, 18 (yo pana bhikkhu atirekacīvaraṃ dhāreyya ~aṃ pācittiyan ti; Sp 639, 17 foll. : taṃ ca cīvaraṃ ~aṃ hoti pācittiyāpatti c’ assa hotī ti attho, atha vā nissajjanaṃ ~aṃ pubbabhāge kattabbassa vinayakammass’ etaṃ nāmaṃ, ~aṃ assa atthī ti ~am icc eva, kiṃ taṃ, pācittiyaṃ); 196, 28 (idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ dasāhātikkantaṃ ~aṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī ti); 235, 35 (dhotāni ~āni honti); V 147, 4 (aniyatā dve honti ~āni tiṃs’ eva); Vin-vn 611 (hoti ~aṃ vatthaṃ); — 2. involving letting fly, throwing ; Sp 304, 14 ([avahāro] ~o nāma anto suṅkaghāte ṭhito bahi suṅkaghātaṃ pāteti); 439, 19 foll. (pāṇātipātassa cha ppayogā sāhatthiko … ~o … ~o ti dūre ṭhitaṃ māretukāmassa … ususattiyanta-pāsāṇādīnaṃ nissajjanaṃ); It-a II 50, 12 (ususatti-ādīnaṃ nissajjanavasena pavatto ~o); — 3. something (to be) discharged or thrown ; Vin III 74, 35 (sayaṃ hanati kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā ~ena vā; Sp 443, 30 : ~enā ti kāyato ca kāyapaṭibaddhato ca mocitena ususatti-ādinā); IV 215, 1 foll. (~ena kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa, ~ena ~aṃ āmasati āpatti dukkaṭassa); Thī-a 234, 28 (rāgavasen’ assā ~ena purisassa ~assā pi phusanā na kappat’ eva); — anissaggiya , mfn. , (what is) not subject to forfeiture ; Vin I 255, 12 (~ena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ); Sp 713, 23 (~-ttā); — see also nissagga, nissaggi.
NCP: pp mfn. & neuter subject to forfeiture; required to be surrendered; (an offense) involving surrendering, involving forfeiture. something (to be) discharged or thrown.
